_statuses.PROVED: a proof is given AND an executable check reproduces it here
_statuses.CONDITIONAL: proved under a stated antecedent that is NOT discharged; the antecedent is in `assumptions`
_statuses.REFUTED: shown false, with a construction that runs
_statuses.KNOWN: established in the cited literature; NOT re-derived here
_statuses.MEASURED: an empirical count from a stated procedure, not a theorem
_statuses.DECLARED: a design decision recorded so it can be attacked; not a truth claim
_statuses.PROVISIONAL: proposed on thin evidence, deliberately not promoted
